description: The chart in Figure 8 represents the distribution of refusal categories for various language models (LMs) on FACTBENCH, comparing the proportions of different refusal reasons across four LMs: GPT4-o, Gemini1.5-Pro, Llama3.1-70B-Instruct, and Llama3.1-405B-Instruct. The chart consists of four pie charts, each representing one of the LMs, with a total of 7-8 slices per chart, although the exact number of slices is not consistent across all charts. The slices are labeled with different refusal categories, including "Safety", "Lack of Knowledge/Capability", "Misinformation", "Ethical Advice", and "Clarification", among others, and are colored differently, although the exact colors are not specified. The percentage values are shown inside or next to each slice, ranging from approximately 0.8% to 75%. No legend is provided, but the labels and percentages are directly displayed on the charts. The slices are not visually emphasized or exploded, and the order of the slices varies across the charts, with no apparent consistent ordering.
